background: Use case: illustration-story. Create a landscape 1536x1024 painterly anime JRPG visual novel BACKGROUND ONLY, matching elegant detailed illustrated fantasy book art. Star-filled deep teal outer space, an enormous blue fantasy planet Fiol with unfamiliar continents curving across lower half, warm ivory golden starlight, quiet majestic setting for audience with a goddess. sprites: Use case: illustration-story. Production animation sprite sheet for painterly anime JRPG visual novel. Six equally sized cells in exactly 3 columns by 2 rows, each full seated figure wholly inside its cell, same fixed camera, identical scale and throne position and character identity in every frame. Transparent background with actual alpha, no environment, no floor, no shadows outside cells, no text, no labels, no grid lines. Adult goddess Dataris, about 30, very long ash-white hair, large ruby-red eyes, curvy mature figure, elegant modest opaque ivory Greek toga with gold trim, gold armlets, on a delicate tall ivory and antique-gold throne. Detailed storybook brushwork, sage shadow palette and warm gold highlights. Each cell must have space around figure without clipping. Left to right top row: 1 dignified poised upright proclamation, one hand resting and other palm open; 2 flustered apologetic expression with one hand raised granting speech; 3 baffled, slouching forward, brows drawn together and eyes slightly crossed. Left to right bottom row: 4 shocked alarm clutching head with BOTH hands, wide red eyes, visibly recoiling; 5 determined enthusiastic with BOTH hands clenched into little fists at chest height; 6 sly side glance, one hand secretly pulling a glossy magazine out from behind throne, other hand extended conjuring. This is a sheet of six animation key poses, not a comic. Render large landscape 1536x1024.
